name: Poseidon's Wrath
description: On success: recharge 1 round & Tidal Echo +30% next Water hit

name: Professor Volt
description: 15% Stun chance on hit · target skips one action

name: Lady Estel
description: Blesses one ally: up to 750 HP

name: Tornado Barrage
description: 200 damage to each enemy; next cast gets +10 accuracy points on hit

name: Crimson Siphon
description: The vampire hits one enemy for 550 base Dark damage. If the hit deals damage, the orb heals the caster for half the mastery-adjusted base hit, capped at missing HP.

name: Dragonfire Descent
description: Baby dragon drops in, charges a giant fireball and hits 650 + 150 to each adjacent enemy. 25% burn: 50 for 3 turns Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Icefang Rampage
description: An icicle-furred polar bear roars, charges and claws one enemy for 640 damage, then disperses

name: Reef Rush
description: A dorsal fin slowly rises and circles before a shark jumps straight up, flops at the apex, then arches downward onto one target and chomps for 520 damage, then splashes back beneath the arena floor

name: Thunderclap
description: A dark thundercloud being with electric-blue eyes forms at the arena center, spreads its arms and claps, firing an arcing bolt at one enemy for 550 damage

name: Flaming Arrows
description: A slanted fire rune circle rains a barrage of flaming arrows across all enemies. Each enemy hit takes 150 total damage with an independent 20% chance to burn for 50 damage at the start of each of the next 3 rounds Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Wind Slashes
description: A wandering samurai drops into the arena, slowly reaches for his sheathed katana, then draws it in a flash and releases three rapid wind slashes at one enemy. Each slash deals 150 damage: 450 total. 80% spell accuracy

name: Reaper
description: A red-eyed hooded Reaper rises from a shadow circle, lunges and slashes for 950 damage. Applies Decaying Strength: the next successful damaging spell against that enemy deals 20% more damage, including all hits of that spell Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Stone Bender
description: An earthbender appears with arms crossed, takes a palm-and-fist stance, then lifts her forward foot and stomps hard in front of her to raise a huge rectangular stone wall. She punches it into a barrage of broken stones, dealing 480 total damage to one enemy

name: Frosty
description: A winter gust reveals a happy snowman. He turns angry, becomes a muscular snow giant and hurls a huge snowball for 400 damage. He melts away after the throw, with a 30% chance to inflict Frostbite: 50 damage per turn for 3 turns Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Solidity
description: An earth-symbol shield travels to yourself or a living ally and dissolves into a Solidity rune. Reduces every hit of the next successful damaging spell by 25%, then expires. Misses and damage over time do not consume it. Does not stack.

name: Calming Waters
description: Calming currents bless yourself or a living ally. Restores 125 HP at the start of each of the next 3 turns: 375 total. Cannot exceed maximum HP or revive a defeated wizard. Reapplying refreshes the duration; it does not stack.

name: Static Shock
description: Curses one enemy with −30 percentage points of spell accuracy for 3 turns (80% becomes 50%). On their first missed spell, discharges for 100 damage and expires. Successful spells leave the curse active until its duration ends.  Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Blazing Rage
description: Fiery energy blesses yourself or a living ally. Their next successful damaging Fire spell deals 25% more damage, including every hit and target of that spell. Misses, healing and support spells preserve it. Refreshes without stacking.

name: Turbulence
description: Restless wind curses one enemy. Their next spell loses 50 percentage points of accuracy. An 80% spell becomes 30% accurate (70% failure). Combines with Static Shock and other active accuracy effects. Consumed on the next cast attempt, whether it succeeds or fails. Does not stack. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Soul Drain
description: Curses one enemy for 3 turns. At the start of each turn, drains up to 100 HP and restores the HP actually drained to the caster, capped at maximum HP. 300 total drain. Cannot revive a defeated caster.  Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Healing Aura
description: Blesses every living teammate, including yourself. Each restores 200 HP at the start of each of the next 3 turns: 600 HP per ally. Capped at maximum HP; cannot revive. Works alongside Calming Waters. Reapplying refreshes this aura without stacking copies.

name: Freezing Temps
description: Marks one enemy. The next successful damaging Ice spell consumes the mark for a 50% chance to freeze them for up to 3 turns. Before each frozen turn, thaw chances rise from 20% to 40% to 60%. Failed thaw rolls skip the turn; automatically unfreezes after the third turn. Misses and other elements preserve the mark. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Scorpion Sting
description: A giant orange scorpion rolls down curled into an armored ball, unfolds, pauses, winds up its tail and stings one enemy for 310 damage. 30% chance to poison for 50 HP per turn for 3 turns, then digs and burrows beneath the arena. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Octo Whip
description: A large blue octopus slams down, flails angrily and whips one enemy for 230 damage. 15% chance to flinch: skips their action this turn only if they have not acted yet. No carryover to the next turn.

name: Devil Boy
description: A small red demon appears in a burst of flames, aims his musket-style pistol and fires a glowing volcanic rock at one enemy for 250 Fire damage, then disappears in another burst of flames.

name: Blooming Spores
description: A huge spotted closed flower bud bulges with pressure, then bursts open into full bloom and releases spore dust, dealing 100 Nature damage to every enemy. Each enemy hit has an independent 30% chance to be poisoned for 50 HP per turn for 3 turns. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Place a debuff rune on yourself for 3 rounds, including this round. Redirect 20% of Lightning spell damage from any wizard into healing for yourself. Active rods share the redirected healing.

name: Undead Rampage
description: A gaunt hooded zombie rips one arm through the ground, then the other, hauls itself free, screeches and pounces onto one enemy for a 200-damage Dark claw strike. On a successful hit, 10% chance to Fear: skips the target only if they have not acted yet this round. No effect if they already acted; never carries into the next round.

name: Forrest Centaur
description: A centaur in woodland leaves, vines and bark garments gallops into position, plants his hooves, draws and charges his bow, then snipes one enemy with a Nature arrow for 570 damage.

name: Wind Dome
description: Rapidly rotating wind forms a protective dome around yourself or a living ally. Blocks the next incoming damaging spell, then disappears. Against Double Pick, it blocks the first pick and the second can hit. Misses, support spells and all damage from debuffs preserve it. Lasts until used; reapplying refreshes one shield without stacking.

name: Ninja Penguins
description: Three ninja penguins flip into the arena with ice kunai. Two launch their teammate diagonally above one enemy; he spins and throws 3 fast kunai for 100 damage each. Each hit has a 15% chance of Frostbite: 50 damage per turn for 3 turns. Frostbite cannot stack or refresh from later kunai. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Blizzard
description: Whipping icy winds rip through every enemy for 160 damage. Each enemy hit has a 60% chance of Extreme Frostbite: 100 damage per turn for 5 turns.  Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Thorny Wrap
description: A thorny vine erupts beneath one enemy and wraps around them for 3 turns. Each spell attempt deals 150 damage to the wrapped caster, even if their spell misses. While attached: −15 accuracy points.  Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Kinetic Sand
description: Sand whirls at the arena center, rises into a towering wave and dives onto one enemy. It encases the target, then clenches in a crushing grip for 620 Earth damage before crumbling away.

name: Zeus’s Might
description: Zeus descends waist-up in a cloud, winds up and hurls his golden thunderbolt for 950 damage. Lightning then chains to each immediate adjacent enemy for 200 damage. Every target hit has an independent 20% chance to lose one action to stun. On a successful cast, skip your next round to recharge.

name: Gunpowder Kiss
description: A mistress made entirely of gunpowder forms from thin air and blows a powder kiss onto one enemy. Gunpowder Coat lasts 3 turns. A Fire spell hit ignites it for 150 extra damage, once per turn and up to 3 times. The coat stays after each explosion.  Burn ticks do not trigger it. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Flow State
description: Put yourself or a living ally in Flow State. The recipient gains 1 extra mana at the start of each of their next 3 turns: 2 mana after casting, or 3 after passing, up to their mana capacity. Lasts for 3 mana gains, including skipped turns. Reapplying refreshes without stacking.

name: Wind Fist Barrage
description: A monk drops into a three-point crouched landing, stands, claps his hands and bows, then takes an open-palm forward stance. He leaps up and unleashes ten forceful wind fists at one enemy: 50 damage per punch, 500 total. 85% spell accuracy.

name: Jack the Lantern
description: A pumpkin-headed scarecrow rises with its head bowed as three crows circle overhead. It lifts its head to face one enemy, sending the crows to swarm for 280 Dark damage. Inflicts Fear for 3 rounds: a 30% chance to skip each turn.  Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Creeping Croc
description: A crocodile floats almost completely submerged toward one enemy, showing only its eyes, the top of its head and its ridged back. It suddenly lunges from the water and snaps for 800 damage. On hit: 10% chance to Fear, skipping the target only if they have not acted yet this round. Never carries into the next round.

name: Electrical Charge
description: Charge yourself or a living ally through the next 3 rounds. The recipient gains 1 mana each time a Lightning spell reaches them, once per cast, up to their mana capacity. Includes chain lightning and Lightning Rod discharge. Misses do not grant mana. Recasting resets the duration.

name: Grill Master
description: A living cast-iron grill heats up under a closed lid, then snaps its jaws open and blasts one enemy for 440 base Fire damage. A successful hit has a 20% chance to Burn for 50 damage per round for 3 rounds. Each wizard can carry four debuff runes.

name: Venus Trap
description: A giant Venus flytrap sprouts at the center of the arena, rears up and roars, then stretches out to engulf one enemy for 400 base Nature damage.

name: Heizmann
description: Slash one enemy for 600 base Ice damage. A 20% Freeze chance seals them in ice. If they remain unfrozen, the shell shatters for another 350 base Ice damage.

name: Boulder Weight
description: Heavy stone pauldrons and sleeves weigh down one enemy. Their spell accuracy drops by 30 percentage points for 3 turns.

name: Cyclops
description: A one-eyed giant roars and flings his heavy club in a flat spin at one enemy for 760 base Earth damage.

name: Acid Air
description: A toxic wind coils around one enemy’s face and inflicts Extreme Poison for 100 base damage at the start of each of the next 5 turns.

name: Decay of Strength
description: Mark one enemy. The next damaging spell against them deals 20% more damage across its hits.

name: Burning Pheonix
description: A blazing ground flame rises into a phoenix. It beats its wings high above the arena and dives into one enemy for 890 base Fire damage.

name: Electro Disc
description: Three electro discs deal 120 damage each to one enemy.

name: Zen
description: Choose one negative rune on yourself or an ally to remove.

name: Scalding Air
description: 140 damage. 40% chance of Extreme Burn: 100 damage per round for 5 rounds.

name: TREE!
description: 720 damage. 30% chance to plant a Healing Seed that transfers up to 75 HP to the caster each round for 5 rounds.

name: Bullet Seed
description: Five seeds deal 30 damage each. 40% chance per cast to apply Healing Seed for 5 rounds.

name: Yeti
description: A yeti breathes frost, charges one enemy, and smashes with both fists.

name: Totally Rad
description: Launches a giant snowball for 320 damage. 15% chance to Freeze on hit.

name: Lightning Ball
description: 315 initial damage. Bounces to a new enemy at 70%, 60%, 50%, then 10 points less per bounce. Each bounce deals 10% less base damage.

name: Wicked Witch
description: 350 Dark damage. Fire, Ice, Poison, and Lightning beams each have a 25% chance. Each has a 30% chance of its matching status: Burn, Frostbite, Poison, or skip this round.

name: Kamikaze?
description: A gremlin plants a bomb, then picks it back up after the fuse goes dark. The explosion hits one enemy for 470 Fire damage.

name: Raging Waters
description: Place a rune on yourself or a living ally. Their next damaging Water spell that lands deals 25% more damage on every hit. Does not stack.

name: Crab Giant
description: A giant crab flexes both pincers, then lunges and clamps one claw shut for 360 Water damage to one enemy.

name: Meteor Shower
description: A staggered meteor barrage deals 420 Earth damage to each enemy. Each meteor has a 25% chance to apply Decay of Strength (+20% damage taken from the next damaging spell).

name: Mana Scourge
description: Mark one enemy until the rune blocks a round-end mana gain. Full mana preserves the rune.

name: Soul Harvest
description: Hook one enemy for 540 base damage and trap their soul in a lantern. Soulless deals 250 damage after 3 rounds.

name: Sirens Melody
description: A siren rises on a rock and sings. Restores up to 350 base HP to each living ally, including you.

name: Quick Sand
description: Lasts 3 rounds. Each cast attempt sinks the target and drains up to 150 HP to heal your living teammate with the lowest current HP, including yourself. The third attempt closes the sand for 250 additional damage.

name: Reikel
description: Pierces one enemy for 670 base Fire damage. On hit, 30% chance to destroy one random beneficial rune. Wind Dome blocks both effects.

name: Crystal Ice Mirrors
description: Mark one enemy for 3 rounds. Each damaging cast has a 40% chance to turn its damage back on the caster instead. Multi-hit spells roll once. Team attacks reflect one target’s share.

name: Electric Eel
description: Coils around one enemy and shocks them for 430 base damage. 25% chance to Stun, skipping their pending action this round.

name: Growth
description: Bless yourself or a living ally. Their next direct Nature heal or damaging cast gains 25% across every hit and target. Rune ticks, misses, and fully blocked casts preserve Growth. Does not stack.

name: Sticks and Stones
description: A cloud rider lifts one stone per living enemy and bats them in succession. Each stone deals 270 base Wind damage and has its own 15% chance to apply Decay of Strength.

name: Dark Sorcerer
description: Slashes every living enemy for 570 base Dark damage. Each enemy hit has a 20% chance to suffer Curse for 50 base damage per round for 3 rounds.

name: Bubble Shield
description: Wrap yourself or a living ally in a 360 HP bubble. It absorbs damage until it pops. Excess damage reaches the wizard. Recasting restores the bubble to 360 HP.

name: Drowzy Flowers
description: Pollen puts one enemy to sleep for up to 3 rounds. Wake chance rises from 20% to 30% to 40%. Wakes automatically on the fourth round.

name: Storm Lizard
description: A skybolt summons a storm lizard. It roars, pivots, and electrocutes one enemy with a tail swipe for 730 base Lightning damage.

name: Volcanic Eruption
description: Lava strikes enemies in random order. Hit chances: 100%, 80%, 60%, 40%. Each hit deals 430 damage with a 30% chance of Extreme Burn (100 per round for 5 rounds).

name: Frozen Touch
description: Mark an enemy. The next damaging Ice spell that hits them gains 25 percentage points of Freeze chance, added to any existing chance.

name: Wynzor
description: A bat-winged wyvern lands, roars, and charges a wind blast in its jaws. The blast deals 910 base Wind damage to one enemy.

name: Sentinel Fissure
description: A towering stone sentinel rises and stomps once, cracking the arena. Debris falls across the field, and a massive stone spire hits each living enemy for 550 base Earth damage. Each enemy independently has a 25% chance to lose its pending action this round.

name: Roggin’ Bowler
description: An ogre hefts a bowling boulder onto its shoulder, points at the enemy, then winds up and rolls it into them for 560 base Earth damage.

name: Ice Blast
description: A quick Ice blast deals 75 base damage to one enemy.

name: Blazing Embers
description: A quick Fire blast deals 85 base damage to one enemy.

name: Rock Blast
description: A quick Earth blast deals 75 base damage to one enemy.

name: Solar Blast
description: A quick Nature blast deals 65 base damage to one enemy.

name: Dark Blast
description: A quick Dark blast deals 80 base damage to one enemy.

name: Shock Blast
description: A quick Lightning blast deals 90 base damage to one enemy.

name: Water Blast
description: A quick Water blast deals 70 base damage to one enemy.

name: Wind Blast
description: A quick Wind blast deals 70 base damage to one enemy.

name: Wind Razor
description: A wind sorcerer hurls a ringed orb of wind at one enemy for 680 base damage. Refunds 1 mana on a critical hit (maximum damage roll).

name: Water Prison
description: Trap one enemy in a rectangular prison of water. They take 150 Water damage at the start of each of the next 3 turns.

name: Lightning Field
description: Storm covers both teams through the next 5 rounds. Lightning spell damage +10%. Wizards without Lightning mastery have a 15% chance to get shocked when casting, skipping for bonus mana.

name: Sunfire
description: A hovering solar warrior hurls a blazing sun at one enemy for 650 base Fire damage. 45% chance of Extreme Burn: 100 damage per turn for 5 turns.

name: Land Ray
description: A buried land ray strikes one enemy with its barbed tail for 385 base Earth damage. 20% chance to Shock and skip their pending action this round.

name: Double Pick
description: Throw two ice picks for 220 base Ice damage each. If the first defeats the target, the second flies at a random surviving enemy.

name: Dark Grounds
description: Covers both teams through the next 5 rounds. Dark damage +10%. Only Dark spells can heal. Healing Seed cannot trigger. Replaces the current environmental rune.

name: Groveland
description: Covers both teams through the next 5 rounds. Nature heals and debuffs are 10% stronger. Healing and standalone debuff casts cannot miss. Nature debuffs on damage spells always trigger on hit.

name: Aromatherapy
description: A pink gust leaves a cleansable debuff rune on the caster. Each living teammate, including the caster, recovers 100 base HP over the next 3 rounds.

name: Flaming Flamingo
description: A one-legged flamingo sweeps the enemy team with fire for 280 base damage each. Each enemy hit has a 20% chance to Burn for 50 damage per round for 3 rounds.

name: Earthquake
description: Shatters the active environmental rune and deals 300 base damage to each living enemy.

name: Clarity Strike
description: Destroy one random negative rune on yourself or an ally. The target gains 1 mana, even if they have no negative rune.

name: Cursed Hold
description: Bind a negative rune to yourself for 3 rounds, including this round. If a foe defeats you, the rune retaliates against them for twice the damage of the finishing hit.

name: Reflective Ice
description: Encase yourself or an ally in reflective ice for 3 rounds, including the casting round. Splits the first damaging spell that gets through: the protected wizard takes half and a random living enemy takes the other half. Then the ice breaks.

name: Thorny Hug
description: A smiling cactus sprouts legs, runs to one enemy, and gives them a prickly hug for 230 base damage.

name: High Tide
description: Floods the arena with rough water and washes away the active environmental rune. Fails if no environmental rune is active.

name: Whale!
description: A huge humpback whale breaches and belly-flops onto the enemy team, dealing 320 base damage to each living enemy.

name: Flame Wheel
description: A flaming monster-truck tire bounces across the arena and slams into one enemy for 200 base damage.

name: Sand Warrior
description: Summon a sand warrior to guard yourself or an ally. His kite shield absorbs up to 250 damage. Excess damage hits the protected wizard, and the warrior crumbles when the shield breaks.

name: Soul Ghoul
description: A ghoul rises in front of an enemy and siphons 320 base HP. It sinks away, then rises before the caster to heal them for 50% of the damage actually dealt. 25% chance to Fear the target and skip their pending action this round.

name: Flashover
description: A ring of fire collapses onto one enemy for 340 base damage. If they are already burning, it deals 140 more base damage. Burn remains active.

name: Briar Remedy
description: A Forest Druid draws all Burn, Poison and Frostbite off yourself or one ally into his staff, then restores 100 HP per effect removed.

name: Lifevine
description: Link yourself to another ally for 3 rounds, including this round. When either wizard regains HP, the other receives 30% of the HP actually restored.

name: Blood Debt
description: Deal 250 base damage and mark the target through the end of the next round. Divert half of their next HP recovery to yourself, up to 200 HP, then consume the mark.

name: Cold Storage
description: Bank 2 mana and 150 HP in an ice crystal for yourself or an ally. It appears as a debuff rune and cracks open at the start of the next round.

name: Glacier Lance
description: A faceted ice spear forms at the center of the arena and pierces one enemy for 390 base damage. Add 120 base damage against Frostbite. Frostbite remains active.

name: Rip Current
description: A low wave hits one enemy for 250 base damage, then returns to heal the living teammate with the lowest current HP for up to 180 base HP, including yourself.

name: Pressure Drop
description: Compress air around one enemy and implode for 310 base damage. Applies Decay of Strength, reducing all hits of their next damaging spell by 25%.

name: Chained Javelin
description: Pierce one enemy for 320 base damage, then siphon up to 2 of their remaining mana back to yourself.

name: Razorang
description: Slice one enemy for 260 base damage, then hook back for 140 against a random living enemy directly above or below them. With no living neighbor, hit the same enemy again.

name: Faultline Bulwark
description: Priority 1. Raise a persistent 400 HP wall that absorbs incoming direct spell damage until destroyed. Excess damage reaches the next protection layer. When it breaks, shards deal 150 damage to the attacker.

name: Live Wire
description: Charge yourself or one ally. Every hit of their next successful damaging Lightning spell deals 25% more damage. Misses leave the charge ready.

name: Hydro Cannon
description: An armored sea turtle emerges in a surge of water, charges both coral-stone cannons and fires two separate water blasts at one enemy for a combined 460 base Water damage.

name: Fountain of Youth
description: Bless yourself or an ally with a Water rune. At the start of each of the next 3 rounds, restore 25% of their missing HP. Reapplication refreshes the duration; cannot revive.

name: Hydro Serpent
description: A massive water serpent rises from a whirlpool, charges a water blast and launches it into the sky above the enemy team. Fires one water blast into the sky per living enemy, then showers every enemy with sharp rain pellets for 430 base Water damage plus 75 per additional blast.

name: Undertow
description: Two giant water hands rise from a whirlpool and pull one enemy downward for 300 base Water damage. Applies a non-stacking Undertow rune: the next successful spell costs 2 additional mana. Passes, misses and unaffordable spells preserve it.

name: Tidal Exchange
description: A crystalline manta ray rises from a whirlpool and channels spiraling water into yourself or a living ally, restoring up to 4 mana without exceeding their maximum.
